task_spec.prompt: Open input/contract-draft.docx. Apply heading styles to all section titles, add page numbers in the footer, and export the result as a PDF to output/contract.pdf.
core_assertions: primary: output PDF file was produced
primary: headings are styled and page numbers present
secondary: content unchanged from the draft
task_spec.setup: 待处理文档为系统提供的 input/contract-draft.docx。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 在此文档上套样式/加页码/导出,勿另起新文档。
